trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. The requirements are lenient — closer to 60% true completion: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, any 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 15 of 18 meditations, plus all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's target decks. Nothing on the checklist is missable; everything can be done in free-roam after the story.

steps.text: Play the story and do optional missions as they appear — you need any 100
Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go
After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list down
Finish any 70 of the 80 challenges — skip the hardest 10

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, wear body armor, and line up 5 enemies at a Gang Operation with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. It doesn't work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels — it rises from shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and you'll likely reach level 4 naturally.

trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn — it gets marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, steal all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch (south-east office), the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' (north-east corner table) and the safe (north-east hallway office — blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police. You don't need all 3 in one visit — the robbery icon respawns, so it's not missable.

steps.text: Follow the Kingpin Bowling marker in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2)
Inside: grab the watch (SE office), the Gutterball shotgun (NE table), the safe (NE hallway office)
Escape the police — the trophy pops after you get away

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch characters. Work out at fitness clubs together — call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) and train side by side: while one works out, the other trains automatically. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (heart icon). You can also work out at home after the story.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, call your partner and go to a fitness club together
Train side by side until both hit maximum Strength
Check progress under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Turn on notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this comes naturally while working on the other trophies. If you're short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops — but don't push into the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight. Check your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.

steps.text: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications
Rob, fight and cause mayhem — every qualifying action counts
Check your count in the trophy list; farm the last few carefully, avoiding Irredeemable

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Complete the UFO easter egg: go solo to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM. A blinking car sometimes spawns at the roadside — if it's not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path from the car into the woods to the UFO (bright blue light in the sky), approach it, and it drops an abducted woman. Talk to her, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.

steps.text: Go solo to the road NW of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2AM
Look for the blinking car at the roadside; if it's absent, drive away and return
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, talk to the abducted woman, offer help, return to her car

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is a running total, not one delivery. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, and this comes naturally from the robberies the 100% checklist wants.

steps.text: Finish Credit Check (Chapter 3) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then fence the marked bills — Yasmani pays most
Reach $250,000 in total laundered

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 purchasable garages (the 4 story garages don't count), costing about $160,000 in total. They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the quickest way to earn the cash.

steps.text: Finish Daily Driver (Chapter 2) to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app
Buy all 8 garages through the app — about $160,000 total

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need free garage space first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose 'Respray' then 'Register'. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.

steps.text: Finish Moses (Chapter 2) to get the Scooter Bros app
Make sure you have free garage space (Little Boxes)
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, Respray then Register — 10 total
